q: An adjunction between two categories C and D (with F: C → D left adjoint to G: D → C) in the context of dynamical systems provides:
opts: A natural bijection Hom_D(FX, Y) ≅ Hom_C(X, GY), often relating different representations of the same dynamics
A functor from flows to maps
exp: Adjunctions in dynamical systems often relate continuous-time flows to discrete-time maps (suspension/Poincaré section adjunction), or relate topological and measurable categories of systems via forgetful/free functors.
